verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents its own bulk-transfer capability, letting users send funds to multiple recipients in one operation via the API and from the dashboard. That is a real first-party bulk operation, but it is shown for payouts only, and the evidence gives no detail on batch limits, status tracking or partial-failure handling. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond transfers (e.g. bulk refunds, bulk subaccount or plan management), documented batch size and error-handling semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
